title: Garage-conversion and ADU permit timeline data for R
text: Package documentation · Interactive permit timeline explorer permittimelines provides R access prepared public building-permit records measuring long residential garage--ADU garage--habitable-room conversion permits waited application issuance Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle. package contains: one row per unique cleaned application, measured wait days issued permits explicit unresolved state rest; application-year cohort completion rates per city; small-cell-suppressed timeline aggregates (percentiles within-N-days shares) per city, review track, project type, permit type group; full provenance, method, caveat metadata. Every bundled number reproducible committed, dependency-free build script data-raw/, fetches directly city’s official open-data portal. number typed hand.

title: Garage-conversion and ADU permit timeline data for R
text: preparation follows five rules, validated live data: Cohorts formed application year, never issue year. large share permits issued given year filed earlier, issue-year grouping oversamples slow permits. Records deduplicated permit number first. Duplicate rows moved comparable San Francisco headline 30%. Review tracks never pooled one median. San Francisco tracks got faster pooled median nearly doubled, purely mix shift. aggregate cell 30 records suppressed. cohorts roughly 75% applications resolved enter aggregates. Recent years censored toward fast permits; row-level records still included, flagged in_mature_cohort = FALSE.

title: Garage-conversion and ADU permit timeline data for R
text: measured wait homeowner’s calendar wait submitting application permit issuance. excludes design, plan preparation, planning review submittal, everything issuance. statutory compliance measure. California Government Code 66317 runs 60-day ADU clock completed application tolls applicant delay; records carry submission date. application empty issued_date issued permit records retrieved. may stalled review abandoned project; records distinguish two, none marked denied. Cross-city level comparison apples--apples; trend within city sound. San Jose excluded published dataset records application date. Sacramento Oakland publish building-permit dataset (checked 2026-08-16).
